title: From Smarter to Hungrier: the Role of Energy Efficiency in Software-defined Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2609.21643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated features and advanced driving support systems have enabled a range of life-saving and comfort applications in modern personal vehicles. Development from mostly mechanical entities towards truly software-defined devices also means that added sensor complexity, processing power, and networking capabilities provide a platform for running even more complex algorithms and applications. As vehicles become smarter, they require even more energy to enable advanced machine learning- and artificial intelligence-based functionalities. This paper discusses the implications for sustainability and the threats to environmental ethics posed by the development of software-defined vehicles. We discuss the balance between introducing more resource-hungry software and hardware components and their effect on society and sustainability. translated_title: 从更智能到更耗能：能效在软件定义汽车中的作用
translated_abstract: 自动化功能和高级驾驶辅助系统已经在现代个人汽车中实现了一系列挽救生命和提升舒适度的应用。汽车从主要作为机械实体向真正软件定义设备的发展，也意味着传感器复杂性的增加、处理能力和网络连接能力为运行更复杂的算法和应用提供了平台。随着汽车变得更加智能，它们需要更多的能量来支持基于高级机器学习和人工智能的功能。本文讨论了软件定义汽车的发展对可持续性的影响以及对环境伦理构成的威胁。我们探讨了引入更多资源消耗型软硬件组件与其对社会和可持续性影响之间的平衡。我们强调了需要新颖的工具来测量、管理和优化能源消耗及其他可持续性指标。
tldr: 本文探讨了软件定义汽车日益智能化所带来的能源消耗增长问题及其对可持续性和环境伦理的威胁，强调亟需开发新的工具来测量、管理和优化车辆的能源消耗。
en_tdlr: This paper examines the growing energy demands of increasingly intelligent software-defined vehicles and their threats to sustainability and environmental ethics, underscoring the need for novel tools to measure, manage, and optimize vehicle energy consumption.
